plan.summary: Implement Observatory class in observatory.py per BRIEF.md and all test contracts. Import and use load_trace/summarize. Build dark UI with title/subtitle, buttons, summary label, canvas with horizontal scroll, detail text with vertical scroll. Cards with role/status colors, click callbacks, outline-only selection. main loads sys.argv[1] or demo.jsonl. Catch OSError/UnicodeError.

steps.action: Implement Observatory.__init__ with dark theme, title/subtitle, buttons, summary_var, canvas, detail, scrollbar widgets.
Implement load_file(path): call load_trace, replace events/warnings, clear detail, draw cards, update summary_var, handle warnings.
Implement select_event(index): validate index, update detail text, change selected card outline color/width only, preserve other cards.
Implement export_summary(path): compute summary via summarize(events), write JSON with summary and warnings keys.
Implement draw(): create event cards with role/status colors, bind click callbacks, set canvas scrollregion.
Implement main(): create root, build Observatory, load file from sys.argv[1] or demo.jsonl, catch OSError/UnicodeError, start mainloop.
